item.title: Machine Learning Electronic Hamiltonian with Long-Range Effects and External Fields
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Xueheng Kuang, Ruoyu Wang, Kwangrae Kim, Rongjing Guo, Yiyang Fu, Yuanyue Liu
arXiv:2611.28450v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Conventional machine-learning electronic Hamiltonian (MLEH) models rely on a local-environment approximation and can miss the effects of long-range (LR) interactions and external fields. Here, we introduce MLEH-LR, a framework that incorporates these effects into Hamiltonian prediction. Benchmarks across materials with different polarizations and dimensionalities demonstrate substantial improvements in the accuracy of the predicted Hamiltonians and resulting electronic structures. MLEH-LR enables accurate, large-scale, high-throughput electronic-structure calculations, as demonstrated for zigzag boron nitride ribbons under transverse electric fields. These calculations allow us to formulate a quantitative relation describing the joint width…

item.title: AmorphGen：利用机器学习和经典原子间势生成非晶结构的 Python 包
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Chaiyawat Kaewmeechai, Louie Slocombe, Alexis G. Manche, David O. Scanlon
AmorphGen 是一个开源 Python 包，用于生成和分析组合物或晶体的无定形结构。化学信息规则估计初始密度并分配分离和配位约束。有三种途径可供选择：随机放置然后松弛、晶体熔融淬火以及对随机结构进行退火和淬火的混合途径。 ASE 提供对经典和机器学习潜力的访问，并为选定的后端提供 GPU 批处理。分析工具计算配位数、键角、环和 X 射线或中子结构因子，以便与测量结果进行比较。 FEFF 代码的可选接口可计算扩展 X 射线吸收精细结构 (EXAFS) 光谱。

item.title: Auditing a superconducting database built by a large language model
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Wenjian Lu
arXiv:2611.29445v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The data on superconducting materials are published as measurements and scattered across the literature, in prose, in tables and in figures, so that gathering them into one place means reading the papers themselves. Large language models (LLMs) can read those papers, and databases built that way are appearing. The difficulty is not the reading but the trust: a number lifted out of a sentence can belong to a neighbouring compound, a computed transition temperature can be recorded without saying that it is computed, and the paper itself may be wrong. This paper describes a pipeline that extracts superconducting materials from the published literature with an LLM, checks every value against its source, and asks how far that checking goes. The p…

item.title: An equivariant classical density functional for ionic fluids at complex interfaces
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Bingqing Cheng
arXiv:2611.28501v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Predicting the combined effects of ionic packing and long-range electrostatics at complex interfaces is technologically important, but remains challenging without atomistic simulations. Here we present a machine-learned classical density functional for ionic fluids that combines a symmetry-adapted neural free energy for short-range correlations with explicit long-range electrostatics. Trained on three-dimensional equilibrium densities and bulk correlations of the full-Coulomb restricted primitive model, a single functional transfers to charge-patterned particles and atomically structured electrodes. Around anisotropic charged solutes, it reproduces the ionic structure and mean forces from molecular dynamics, including reversals of the bare e…

item.title: JAX-Nano: A GPU-Accelerated Differentiable Phonon Boltzmann Transport Solver for Nanoscale Heat Transfer
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Bo Zhang, Amy Zhaomei Zhang
arXiv:2611.28926v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As semiconductor device dimensions approach phonon mean free paths, heat transport enters ballistic and quasi-ballistic regimes where Fourier's law becomes inadequate. The phonon Boltzmann transport equation (BTE) describes these nonequilibrium effects but presents significant computational challenges. This work introduces JAX-Nano, a GPU-accelerated, end-to-end differentiable phonon BTE solver for nanoscale heat transport. The solver integrates steady-state and transient BTE formulations within a unified finite-volume framework, supporting structured and unstructured meshes, mode-resolved transport, phonon scattering, volumetric heat generation, and multiple boundary conditions. Automatic differentiation enables gradient computation with re…

item.title: IADR: Interface-Augmented Neural Operator for Phase-Field Mean-Curvature Flow
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Qinyi Zhang, Duanyu Feng, Yangshuai Wang, Hao Wang
arXiv:2611.30153v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Allen-Cahn equation is one of the standard phase-field models for mean-curvature flow (MCF), parameterised by the diffuse-interface width ε. Practical simulations span a range of ε, so a single model covering this range is needed. PDE-specific neural operators are accurate but must be retrained at every ε; general neural operators cover ε in one model but lose the phase-field structure of the target. We introduce Interface-Augmented Diffusion-Reaction (IADR), a neural operator that addresses both shortcomings: a target network with a diffusion-and-reaction (DR) structure preserves the phase-field structure of the Allen-Cahn equation, while a hypernetwork that maps ε to the weights of this target network amortises the dependence on ε acro…

item.title: 过渡金属二硫化物大型超晶胞中精确准粒子能级的图神经网络
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Rafael R. Del Grande, David A. Strubbe
GW 方法是材料科学界精确计算材料电子带隙的主要工具之一，因为它克服了密度泛函理论 (DFT) 的带隙低估问题。尽管其准确性很高，但当计算原子数超过 10-100 时，其计算成本就会变得过高，这使得其在需要大型超级晶胞的缺陷、表面和莫尔系统中的使用变得更加困难。为了克服这个问题，我们开发了一个用较小的 GW 计算训练的图神经网络，它可以以很小的计算成本对大型超级细胞进行准确的预测。

arXiv:2603.18710v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Among wurtzite-type ferroelectrics, scandium-doped aluminum nitride (ScAlN) has emerged as a leading candidate for CMOS-compatible low-voltage memory, combining strong spontaneous polarization with process compatibility. A remarkable feature of this system is the pronounced reduction of the coercive field (E_c) with increasing Sc concentration; however, its microscopic origin remains poorly understood at the atomic scale, particularly under finite temperature and applied electric fields. Here, we employ an atomistic simulation framework that integrates a density-functional-theory-accurate machine-learning force field with an equivariant neural-network-based Born effective charge model to perform large-scale electric-field-induced molecul…

item.title: CrysLDM: Latent Diffusion Model for Crystal Material Generation
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Subhojyoti Khastagir, Kishalay Das, Pawan Goyal, Seung-Cheol Lee, Satadeep Bhattacharjee, Niloy Ganguly
arXiv:2611.29675v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Generating new crystal materials with desirable chemical properties has long been a challenging task. Existing diffusion models operate in feature space, requiring complex diffusion architectures to model the joint distribution of atom types, coordinates, and lattice structures. This complexity increases the number of diffusion steps, leading to higher training and sampling costs. In this work, we aim to generate novel crystal materials within a time- and resource-constrained setup, where existing models are not well-suited. To address this, we propose CrysLDM, a novel latent diffusion model for 3D crystal materials, which integrates a variational autoencoder and a diffusion model. The VAE encoder maps 3D crystal structures into a latent spa…

item.title: PACSYLLM: natural-language access to an expanded PACSY database of protein structures and chemical shifts
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Abigail Chiu, Woonghee Lee
Chemical shifts are the first data obtained in protein NMR studies, and their relationship to three-dimensional structure underlies resonance assignment, secondary-structure analysis, and structure determination. In 2012, PACSY made this relationship searchable by integrating NMR structures from the Protein Data Bank (PDB), chemical shifts from the Biological Magnetic Resonance Data Bank (BMRB), and fold classifications from the Structural Classification of Proteins (SCOP). Many analyses, however, still require SQL queries or custom scripts. Here, we describe a rebuilt, quality-controlled PACSY database and PACSYLLM, a natural-language interface to its data. The database holds 11,537 PDB/BMRB chain pairs, 10,881 of them protein chains, with 7.9 million chemical shifts and 239 million atom…

item.title: Anatomy of orbital and spin responses in GaAs and Si: Hall, inverse Faraday, and magneto-optical Kerr effects
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Sanaz Alikhah, Daegeun Jo, Peter M. Oppeneer
arXiv:2611.30297v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magneto-optical signals in nonmagnetic semiconductors entangle spin and orbital contributions, both in angular-momentum generation and magneto-optical detection. We calculate these contributions for electron-doped GaAs and Si using density-functional theory, linear-response theory, and a second-order density-matrix treatment of the inverse Faraday effect. At small electron doping, the intrinsic orbital Hall conductivity exceeds its spin counterpart in magnitude, while the orbital contribution to light-induced magnetization dominates over broad photon-energy ranges. We show that orbital- and spin-resolved optical Hall and polar Kerr coefficients exhibit stronger sensitivity to orbital moments than to equal spin moments. This contrast reflects…

item.title: DeepDOSReasoner：用于状态密度预测和材料发现的物理推理
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Yingheng Wang, Francesco Ricci, Zhilong Wang, Tao Yu, Junwen Bai, Xiangyun Lei 等10位作者
从原子结构预测材料的行为是物理科学的长期目标。电子态和声子态密度（eDOS 和 phDOS）控制着关键的电子、光学、振动和热力学性质，但使用密度泛函理论 (DFT) 进行计算的成本很高：大约 60% 的材料项目条目缺乏 eDOS，超过 80% 缺乏 phDOS。现有的晶体到光谱模型依赖于池结构表示和逐点回归，这模糊了光谱特征并违反了总状态守恒。

👤 Leon Otis, Jo Kurian, James Shee
arXiv:2611.29858v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: While projector quantum Monte Carlo methods are known for producing accurate ground-state energies, the prediction of other properties that encode the electronic response to applied electric and magnetic fields has historically been challenging. In this work we demonstrate that the electric (static) polarizability tensor, which is formally a second-derivative of the energy with respect to electric fields, can be efficiently computed with phaseless auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo using a correlated sampling finite-difference strategy. With simple Hartree-Fock trial wave functions, we investigate a series of small molecules (some of which are difficult for approximate density functionals), polyacenes of increasing size, and ferrocene as…

item.description:

👤 Thomas Chuna, Phil-Alexander Hofmann, Alexander Benedix-Robles, Tobias Dornheim
arXiv:2606.19205v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Many fields of physics use quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) simulations to simulate quantum systems in imaginary-time τ and estimate imaginary-time correlation functions (ITCF). However, extracting dynamic ω-dependent quantities from ITCFs is a notoriously difficult task, known as analytic continuation (AC), that amounts to solving an exponentially ill-conditioned inverse problem. Within the AC literature, there are competing stochastic and regularized approaches, as well as an emerging collection of works using parameterized models like neural networks. Here we transcend the traditional divides between the communities, introducing the regularized stochastic optimization method (RSOM). This method reformulates AC as a dictionary learning proble…

item.title: 电化学电池和电催化系统的界面和耐久性的最新进展
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Ameer Baig Ali Baig, R. Sagayaraj
电池、燃料电池、电解槽和电催化反应器通常单独讨论，但它们往往在同一个地方失效：界面。本综述借鉴了 2019 年至 2026 年间发表的 102 篇开放获取文章，追踪了细胞和催化剂的线索，并收集了其中报告的定量结果。无机固体电解质的电导率范围为 10⁻⁵ 至 10⁻² S cm⁻1（具体取决于类别），达到最高值的硫化物很容易出现界面和水分问题。液碱、阴离子交换和质子交换电池中电解槽的运行温度为 40–90°C，固体氧化物电池中电解槽的运行温度为 600–850°C。

item.title: Real-time optimization with online learning for pressure swing adsorption
item.description:

👤 Carine de Menezes Rebello, Marcio Fontana, Leizer Schnitman, Idelfonso B. R. Nogueira
arXiv:2611.30828v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Real-time optimization (RTO) of pressure swing adsorption (PSA) units requires a process model that can be evaluated many times at each decision, which favours data-driven surrogates of the cyclic steady state. A surrogate, however, represents the plant only under the conditions covered by its training data, and disturbances that are not among its inputs remain outside its description. This work presents an RTO framework for PSA in which a neural network surrogate, optimized by particle swarm, is updated online with data generated at the plant when plant and model diverge. A rigorous dynamic model of a CH₄/CO₂ separation, integrated to cyclic steady state, served as virtual plant in three scenarios. In the first, five consecutive RTO events…

Phys. 145 (2016) 224110] by using information contained in potential derivatives to decrease the number of required potential points. item.title: Bridging electrode preparation and electrocatalyst performance with physics-based causal AI using Bayesian Structural Causal Models
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Evelyna Wang, Linda Hung, Sam Witty, Michaela Burke Stevens, Kevin Tran
arXiv:2606.30898v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: State-of-the-art artificial intelligence (AI) and Machine-Learning (ML) tools have not yet enabled rapid design of next-generation materials. Detailed physical understanding of how material properties affect device performance is required to advance materials development. For example, optimization of ink parameters for electrocatalysts has no known physical mathematical model and thus insights are difficult to translate from material studies to device studies. item.title: A Fractional Chern Semimetal: Exact Wavefunction and Conformal Criticality
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Fa-Jie Wang, Yang Qi, Zhi-Da Song
arXiv:2611.31234v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Unlike fractional quantum Hall states in uniform Landau levels, fractional Chern insulators can host dispersive anyon bands, raising the question of what happens when the anyon gap closes. We construct an exact finite-bond-dimension tensor-network state for a fractional Chern semimetal by Gutzwiller projecting a critical parton state. This state exhibits divergent correlation lengths in charged sectors but a fractionally quantized many-body Chern number of 1/3. Although it has one electron per unit cell, its modular S and T matrices and entanglement spectrum match those of the ν=1/3 Laughlin state. We identify a (1+1)--dimensional U(3)₁× SU(3)₁ conformal field theory (CFT) governing the wavefunction norm in the infrared, an unexpected result…

item.title: Dirac-like bands and weak-field transverse transport in ABA trilayer graphene
item.description:

arXiv:2611.30924v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The low-energy electronic structure of ABA trilayer graphene is composed of light and heavy electron branches, which can be altered by an out-of-plane displacement field. Here, we show that, depending on the values of Slonczewski-Weiss-McClure parameters, a displacement field can inflict a band edge inversion, for which we identify the inversion conditions. This inversion is accompanied by a reversal of Berry curvature and giant topological magnetic moments at the band edges. In a weak perpendicular magnetic field, those topological magnetic moments produce valley splitting, giving rise to distinct anomalous transverse electrical and thermoelectric responses. These features offer a potential route to detecting the band inversion and constrai…

item.title: High-temperature superconductivity from kinetic energy
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Hanbit Oh, Hui Yang, Ya-Hui Zhang
arXiv:2411.07292v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Superconductivity is usually assumed to arise from attractive interaction. In this work we show that strong pairing is possible soley from kinetic energy even without a net attraction. We demonstrate a high-temperature kinetic superconductor in a simple lattice model with nearest-neighbor hopping (t) projected onto a constrained Hilbert space, analogous to the t-J model with J=0, where kinetic magnetism has been previously studied. Using density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) on cylinders up to width L_y=8, we find a superconducting ground state exhibiting a key difference from high-T_c cuprates: both the pairing gap and phase stiffness increase with doping (x). We find pairing gaps, determined from spin and single-electron charge g…

item.title: MagPot：用于分子动力学模拟的磁弹性势发生器
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 P. Nieves, I. Korniienko, S. Arapan, A. Fraile, R. Iglesias, D. Legut
磁弹性现象源于原子位移和磁自由度之间的耦合，其原子模拟需要原子间模型，其中磁相互作用明确取决于原子间距离。本文介绍了 MagPot，这是一个 Python 程序，它使用大型原子/分子大规模并行模拟器 (LAMMPS) 的 SPIN 包生成用于自旋晶格分子动力学模拟的 Bethe-Slater 参数集。该程序从一组紧凑的材料属性中确定描述海森堡交换的径向函数以及双离子尼尔相互作用的偶极子和四极子贡献。 1.0 版支持具有铁磁和反铁磁配置的简单立方、体心立方和面心立方晶格。

item.title: Minimal Three-Band Model and d-Wave Superconductivity in La₄Ni₃O₈
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Ao Zhang, Chao Deng, Wenfeng Wu, Run Yang, Zhixiang Shi, Liang Si
arXiv:2611.28747v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Motivated by the recent observation of ambient-pressure superconductivity in Pr- and Y-substituted La₄Ni₃O₈, we combined density-functional theory (DFT), dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT), random phase approximation (RPA), and fluctuation exchange approximation (FLEX) methods to study its electronic structure and superconducting pairing symmetry. DFT band analysis indicates that the low-energy states are mainly dominated by three Ni-3dₓ^₂₋y^₂ orbitals with weak d-p hybridization. Multi-orbital DMFT calculations yield an average dₓ^₂₋y^₂ filling of about 0.87, close to the optimal value for infinite-layer nickelates. By comparing the DMFT results of dₓ^₂₋y^₂ only and full Ni-3d models, we find that their electronic properties are almost comp…

item.title: Molecular Pawns on a Surface Chessboard: Computational Investigation of Nanographenes with Atomistic Methods
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Antonio Lorenzo Mariano, Jacopo Lupi, Emilio Lorini, Matteo Briganti
arXiv:2611.30917v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Atomically precise nanographenes combine tunable electronic topology with localized, coherent spin states, making them candidate platforms for molecular quantum technologies. This review examines the multiscale theoretical framework governing these systems: the hierarchy of computational methods for describing magnetic properties, the substrate-molecule interface, on-surface synthetic kinetics, and supramolecular self-assembly. We highlight how density functional theory, automated reaction-path discovery, and spin-aware machine-learned interatomic potentials connect static electronic structure to mesoscale dynamics, and how magnetic exchange, optical excitations, and spin transport can be predicted before synthesis.

item.title: 3D 跨维量子反常霍尔系统中的量子霍尔效应
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Liang-Liang Cheng, Ao-Long Li, Zhi-Qiang Zhang, Hua Jiang
我们系统地研究了 3D 量子反常霍尔效应系统中的跨维度输运和由此产生的量子霍尔效应，该系统是通过耦合两个 Weyl 半金属哈密顿量构建的。我们的研究表明，该系统具有高度各向异性的表面态和手性模式，从而产生丰富的量子霍尔响应。至关重要的是，我们阐明了沿三个高对称方向施加的磁场如何决定陈数、手性模式和霍尔响应的演变。我们发现沿不同方向的手性模式可能源自不同的机制，从而产生各种磁调制特性。此外，我们揭示了磁场下传统的基于陈数的体边界对应的分解，其中陈数本身无法完全表征手性态的演化。

Combining projective symmetry group analysis with variational Monte Carlo, we construct and optimize Hdet states in various symmetry classes. item.title: Valence band, electron correlation, and possible temperature dependent change in the electronic structure near E_F of a candidate of ambient-pressure nickelate superconductors Sr₃Ni₂O₅Cl₂

item.title: Approximating thermodynamic equilibrium observables of quasi one-dimensional magnetic molecules and chains by thermal DMRG - a user perspective
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 L. Horstmann, J. Schnack
arXiv:2608.24608v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Density matrix renormalization group methods or tensor network methods in general can not only be used to determine ground states but also to evaluate thermal equilibrium properties. Although convergence is superior for one-dimensional quantum spin systems with nearest neighbor exchange and open boundary conditions, the hope is that these methods can as well be employed to approximate magnetic observables of magnetic molecules with more complex interaction patterns. Here, we assume the position of a user and study the accuracy that can realistically be achieved for several archetypical quasi one-dimensional structures using the TenPy suite. item.title: 压痕诱导的电荷密度波半导体EuTe4极性畴重构
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Hidefumi Takahashi, Yuki Umewaka, Kiichiro Yoshida, Ritsuto Nakamura, Akitoshi Nakano, Takao Matsumura 等10位作者
通过外加电场控制导电材料中的极性畴可以实现基于极化的电子功能，但仍存在实验上的挑战。虽然人们已提出由局部应变、应力或应变梯度驱动的机械致动作为一种无需外加电压的途径，但其在相对导电的极性材料中的实验示范仍然有限。本文展示了在室温下，电荷密度波（CDW）半导体EuTe4中机械诱导的极性畴重构，其电阻率在10 mΩcm量级。偏振光显微镜和二阶谐波产生测量揭示了CDW诱导的平面内极化畴，其畴构型约为90 ^circ。

item.title: High-Throughput Screening of Phononic Bandgap in Experimentally Realized Materials
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Mohammad Bagheri, Kameyab Raza Abidi, Pekka Koskinen
arXiv:2611.30344v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Materials with a phonon band gap offer a unique mechanism to restrict phonon scattering, making them promising candidates for developing functional materials for targeted thermal applications. Unlocking this mechanism across broad material classes requires systematic exploration, but first-principles methods and experiments are too expensive.
